notes: Both demonstrative phrases write a single determiner *that*, taken by the written pronoun; all four articles in them are unrepresented under rule 41's limit.
The resumptive הוּא of the relative clause is unrepresented under rule 22: the written אֲשֶׁר supplies the English subject and the copula goes to the predicate adjective under rule 20.
The apodosis waw before נִכְרְתָה is unrepresented, since the ASV opens that clause with no connective.
